title: Ennék, Innék, Mennék – Some Everyday -nék Verbs

sections.title: Same ending, a changed stem
sections.content: eszik ("to eat"), iszik ("to drink") and megy ("to go") already change shape in the past tense (ettem, ittam, mentem) — in the conditional they change again, to ennék, innék and mennék. The ending is still the very same -nék you just met; only the stem looks different, the same way it already did in the past tense.

items.english: I'd gladly go to the cinema with you.

sections.content: These look like exceptions, but the pattern is the same one you already know: eat/drink/go build a special stem before adding an ending, and -nék is just the latest ending that stem takes.
